name: Zhihu Content Pipeline
description: A pluggable Zhihu content-creation system: five role characters (scout / editor / researcher / writer / polisher), Zhihu writing skills, and MCP presets that wrap zget-cli, Exa, Fetch, Sequential Thinking, and a CloakBrowser stealth browser. Find hot topics, research, draft a high-vote answer, and save it as a draft.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: Characters, skills, and MCP presets load in the browser; spawning the MCP servers (zget / browser) requires the Tauri sidecar.

mobile.reason: Characters and skills load on mobile; spawning the MCP servers (zget / browser) needs the desktop sidecar.

commands.name: /zhihu
commands.description: Open the Zhihu content pipeline panel.
